 Colorado’s Hoedown Hill Drops Skiing to Focus on Festivals
 Quinn Brophy | November 10, 2026 | Industry News 
 Share this article 
 -->
 Located near Fort Collins, Colorado, Hoedown Hill has offered beginner-friendly and terrain park skiing and snowboarding since opening in January 2024. | Credit: Hoedown Hill Facebook 
 When Hoedown Hill opened in January 2024, it was Colorado’s newest ski resort, offering beginner-friendly and terrain park skiing for guests in the Fort Collins area. But less than three years later, the ski area is heading in a different direction.
 Hoedown Hill recently announced it was abandoning its skiing operations to focus exclusively on live music and outdoor entertainment.  Over the past three summers, the 12-acre resort hosted multiple multi-day music festivals, drawing thousands of music fans and keeping busy all summer long. With music sitting at the heart of Hoedown Hill’s brand, leadership has decided to shift its focus fully on creating the best concert experience possible.
 “Music has always been the heartbeat of Hoedown Hill,” CEO of TWVC Hospitality Tyler Lind said in a press release . “Every festival, we’ve watched thousands of people come together on this hill and have the time of their lives. That’s what Hoedown Hill does best, so we’re going all in on it. We can’t wait to show Northern Colorado what’s next.”
 Related: Loveland, CO, Report: Opening Day with Nice Vert & Fast Laps 
 Hoedown Hill hosted its first music festival in the summer of 2024 and has grown to become one of Northern Colorado’s premier music festival venues, bringing in dozens of popular bands and musicians.  
 “Over the years, the festival stage has welcomed Third Eye Blind, Cold War Kids, Plain White T’s, Randy Houser, The Band Perry, Chris Lane, Asia featuring John Payne, Steve Augeri (former lead vocalist of Journey), Anna Avery, Dasha and more,” the Hill wrote in its release. “This past summer, the free concert series brought neighbors, families and friends out for live music under the Colorado sky.”
 Hoedown Hill has already begun planning its summer 2027 lineup, with event announcements to come in the months ahead. As it prepares for this upcoming summer, Hoedown Hill will not offer skiing, snowboarding, or tubing this winter as the team focuses on its entertainment calendar.
 Related: Breckenridge Opens for the 2026-27 Season Wednesday 
 While Hoedown Hill will not offer winter sports on its land this winter, it did not 100% rule out the possibility of returning to skiing and snowboarding offerings in the future.  
 “Any future winter programming will be announced as plans develop,” the former ski area wrote in its press release.  
 With Hoedown Hill officially axing skiing and snowboarding for the 2026-27 season, skiers in the Fort Collins area will miss out on the convenience of a ski area just minutes from downtown.  Instead, Fort Collins skiers looking to get out on the hill will have to look further west to resorts like Loveland , Eldora , Keystone , and Winter Park . While those resorts are much further away, they offer a much more extensive skiing experience. Hoedown Hill was home to only about 12 to 14 acres of skiable terrain and roughly 130 to 200 feet of vertical drop, while resorts like Loveland offer over 1,000 acres of skiable terrain.
 Although it won’t be skiing for the foreseeable future, guests can still enjoy the Hill in a fun, interactive way by attending one of its music festivals.  
 “Hoedown Hill has always been about bringing people together for great music, and our fans are the reason those nights feel so big,” Lind said. “The best nights at Hoedown Hill are still ahead of us. Get on the list now, because you’re going to want to hear about 2027 first.”
 Hoedown Hill will focus on its music festival experience. | Credit: Hoedown Hill Facebook
